_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

clinics.basis: clinics across Southeast Texas, more than

share_using.basis: share of UTMB clinicians actively using OpenEvidence, more than, with no denominator printed

live_month.basis: month the integration went live, no year printed

months_live.basis: calendar months from the go-live month to the release month, March to September

days_effective_to_release.basis: days from the statute taking effect to UTMB's release

bill.basis: the Senate bill that added the section

contract_first.basis: dollars, after the October 2025 first amendment

contract_multiple.basis: total over initial, rounded to one decimal

institutions.basis: UT System health-related institutions the third amendment extends to

regents_meeting.basis: first day of the Regents' next regular meeting

days_to_meeting.basis: days from October 9th, 2026, the run date, to the meeting's first day

hours_notice.basis: hours ahead a person gives a name and topic

vendor_consultations_m.basis: millions of consultations OpenEvidence says it has supported, more than

release_percent_figures.basis: percent figures in the body of UTMB's release of September 22nd, scanned from the saved copy

release_accuracy_mentions.basis: mentions of accuracy, an error rate or an outcome in the body of the release

release_diagnostic_mentions.basis: uses of any form of diagnose, diagnosis or diagnostic in the body of the release, the statute's term

release_patient_mentions.basis: mentions of patients in the body of the release
